b: I (38M) have been married for 4 years, with two young kids. The same day I arrived at a clinic where I’m staying for 3 weeks, I found an email my wife had sent to her ex, right after I left, who she hadn’t contacted in 5 years. We have access to each other’s accounts, and she had forgotten that.

The email isn’t sexual or flirty. It’s melancholic. She says she dreams about him, that there are things she wants to tell him, and that she’s “something far in the past” for him. She also never mentioned that she’s married. After he didn’t respond warmly, she deleted the message.

I'm pretty hurt by the secrecy and the fact that she reached out to him. She’s been feeling low for a while, and we’ve been fighting more. I’ve tried to help, but it feels like nothing is enough and I’m always the one at fault.

I haven’t told her I saw it. We only talk about the kids. Part of me can’t believe this is real and can’t imagine not being with her. Another part feels trust is gone and nothing she says could fix it. I’m even disgusted when I see that she tries to contact me, even if it's about the kids. I’m just… feeling lost, if I’m honest. I don't know what to do or even what to feel.
What would you do in my shoes?
TLDR: My wife contacted her ex while I was away and I'm so shocked I'm not even sure what to feel or do.
